input.summary: Insert exit clause: 90 days of transition assistance and 30-day data export on any expiry or termination.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 5.2 obliges MSL to assist the transfer of responsibilities but fixes no duration, and the return period is left blank, so we have added a short exit provision giving us at least ninety (90) Days of transition assistance and export of our data within thirty (30) Days after any expiration or termination. This is our fallback transition position.

ops.text: Upon the expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, MSL will, at IBM's request, provide the transition assistance described in Section 5.2 a) ii) for a period of at least ninety (90) Days, and within thirty (30) Days after such expiration or termination MSL will export and deliver to IBM all IBM data in MSL's possession or control.
